The context every other Wix tool assumes. Call it first, once per conversation, for any Wix task or question; for another site later in the conversation, call `GetSiteContext` instead of calling this again.
A Wix task includes reading or changing a site's or account's data: product

tools.name: ReadFullDocsArticle
tools.description:
Fetches the full Wix docs article or method article with code examples for using the method.
Docs articles looks like this: https://dev.wix.com/docs/... and they can either be general docs articles or method articles.
Also reads Wix skills pages — https://www.wix.com/skills/<skill>, https://dev.wix.

tools.description:
Create a new visitor session and obtain a visitor access token for site "CodeStringers" (https://www.codestringers.com/_api/mcp).
You must use this tool before calling CallWixSiteAPI for this first time.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "WixREADME" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: # Tool: WixREADME The context every other Wix tool assumes. Call it first, once per conversation, for any Wix task or question; for another site later in the co…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, SearchSiteApiDocs, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Private data: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, CallWixSiteAPI, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Public sink: WixREADME, ExecuteWixAPI · Destructive: ExecuteWixAPI.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, SearchSiteApiDocs, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Private data: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, CallWixSiteAPI, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Public sink: WixREADME, ExecuteWixAPI · Destructive: ExecuteWixAPI

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
